audience: HR teams and team leads that manage absences, leave balances and attendance in Calamari

useCases.title: See who is clocked in right now
useCases.text: List each employee's current shift status: started, stopped or on break. Read the status of one employee.

useCases.title: Check who is off in a date range
useCases.text: List absence requests in a date range, filtered by absence type, team or position.

useCases.title: Check leave balances before a request
useCases.text: Read one employee's balance for every absence type on a date. Compare the balances of a team.

useCases.title: Review timesheet balances for a team
useCases.text: Show worked-time balances, overtime or deficit, in a date range, filtered by team, position or contract type.

useCases.title: Create an absence request for an employee
useCases.text: Create an absence request for one employee. It notifies the approvers, and the balance is used once approved.

useCases.title: Create a team with its members
useCases.text: Create a team with its members and managers, given as Calamari person ids.
